01 / The big picture

What is NOD?

NOD is an all-in-one Android utility tool designed to bring powerful device-management features together in a single app, with its own built-in NOD ADB Engine.

✧

One tool. More control.

NOD aims to make useful device tools easier to access without requiring users to rely on separate apps for its core ADB-powered workflow.

Built-in ADB EngineFree to useDevice tools
01
Its own NOD ADB EngineNOD includes its own ADB engine, helping users access NOD's supported tools without depending on separate apps for that workflow.
02
Features available for freeMany apps offer only a handful of free features and lock the rest behind a premium paywall. NOD takes a different approach: its features are offered free of charge, and the app can be downloaded at no cost.
03
Powerful device-management toolsThrough its ADB engine, NOD provides tools such as system overlays, Performance Lab, and options to disable, enable, debloat, or uninstall apps where supported.
!
Use these tools responsiblyDevice-management actions can affect app or system behaviour. Review each action carefully and use these features at your own responsibility; removing or disabling essential components may cause problems.

Important: static-site limitations

Edits are saved in this browser first. Download the latest updated HTML to carry those edits into a shareable file; uploading that file publishes the embedded snapshot to visitors. A static HTML file cannot silently rewrite itself, and a client-side key check can be bypassed by a technically capable visitor. For instant cross-device editing and genuinely private owner authentication, use a secured server-side database.
